query:
INSERT INTO users (oidc_issuer, oidc_subject, email, display_name, last_login_at)
             VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, now())
             ON CONFLICT (oidc_issuer, oidc_subject) DO UPDATE SET
               email = EXCLUDED.email, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, last_login_at = now()
             RETURNING id
